primary_endpoint: between-subgroup AUROC difference for ONE model: AUROC(active TB vs negatives without previous TB) minus AUROC(active TB vs negatives with previous TB)
secondary_endpoint: difference in differences against a commercial comparator scored on identical participants
method: empirical SE from a 10000-replicate stratified bootstrap on the Vietnam cohort (positives shared within replicate), extrapolated as SE proportional to 1/sqrt(n) at fixed design, then inverted: n = n0 * ((z_a + z_b) * SE0 / delta)^2
assumptions: a new cohort with a similar design: ~10% prevalence, ~35% of negatives with previous TB, one image per patient
similar class-conditional score distributions, so a similar SE at a given n
SE scales as 1/sqrt(n); approximate normality of the difference
NO multiplicity adjustment included in the headline numbers; see the sensitivity analysis for a Bonferroni-adjusted version
the Vietnam SE is itself estimated and carries its own uncertainty

sensitivity_analyses.note_previous_TB_fraction: Kagujje et al. observed 24%; Vietnam has 35%. The scaling shown is approximate: it assumes the SE is driven by the size of the smaller negative stratum.
sensitivity_analyses.note_prevalence: the positives are shared by both subgroup AUROCs, so they drive the SE; halving prevalence roughly doubles the requirement.

multiplicity_bonferroni_5_subgroup_varia.rationale: five clinical variables were screened before previous TB was selected, so a confirmatory study should budget for that.
